name: shiksha-onboarding-profile-tutorial
title: Set up your learner profile

chapters.caption: 01  Begin after sign-in and choose the name you want your tutor to use.
02  Add a hometown and a familiar language for a more personal profile.
03  Share your interests and finish the first-run setup.
04  Open Settings to review the profile saved during onboarding.
05  Update a profile detail, then save and verify the confirmed value.
06  Return to the library and begin learning with four course starters.

description: Complete the actual first-run onboarding, review the saved profile in Settings, update a detail and begin a course.

savedProfile.passionateAbout: Science puzzles, drawing and learning how things work.

verification.provenance: Fresh synthetic signed-in learner; onboarding and profile writes are intercepted in memory, not persisted to a real account.

capture: Actual unchanged React frontend; scripted interactions, synthetic course data and in-memory API responses.
timing: Captured frames are paced for readability, not a performance benchmark.
isolation: Fresh browser context. External services blocked; all API calls simulated. No remote course creation.
